title: F-4F Phantom II (Luftwaffe, pilot)

sources.title: McDonnell Douglas F-4 Phantom II (Wikipedia), F-4F
JoyPro cockpit catalog (panels, items and grip functions of the variant)

intro: The F-4F is the German version of the F-4E Phantom II: a big two-seat fighter-bomber with two engines, made lighter for the Luftwaffe and at first without the radar-guided Sparrow missile. The ICE upgrade of the 1990s gave it a modern APG-65 radar and the AMRAAM missile. JoyPro assumes the pilot has the same stick and throttles as in the F-4E, so this guide follows the DCS F-4E cockpit; it is not checked against a Luftwaffe manual. JoyPro does not count the small forward hand control of the F-4E (for steering the seeker of guided weapons) as a bindable control of this version.
